info.name: Ventrix — Complete API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the Ventrix multi-industry ERP SaaS.

**Setup:**
1. Set `baseUrl` variable → `http://localhost:8000`
2. Run **Login** request — token is saved automatically via test script
3. All subsequent requests use `{{token}}` automatically

**Variables used:**
- `baseUrl` — API server (default: http://localhost:8000)
- `token` — JWT access token (auto-set on login)
- `refreshToken` — JWT refresh token (auto-set on login)
- `organizationId` — current org ID (auto-set on login)
- `invoiceId`, `customerId`, `productId`, etc. — set from responses as you go

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: Register, login, refresh tokens, Google OAuth, 2FA, password reset
